title: Zesty Middle Eastern Eggplant Flatbread
description: A charred and chewy Middle Eastern inspired flatbread featuring roasted eggplant, thyme, and a wood fired bake, perfect for a vegetarian friendly brunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, and sumac.
Roast the eggplant slices in the oven for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Meanwhile, toast the flatbread in the oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of garlic on each toasted flatbread piece.
Top each flatbread with a roasted eggplant slice, a sprinkle of thyme, and a crumble of feta cheese.
Drizzle the tops with olive oil and sprinkle with sumac.
Return the flatbreads to the oven for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
